title: Yvette Cooper says Labour ‘did not do government very well’ under Starmer

paragraphs.en: Yvette Cooper admits Labour has “not done government very well” in the last couple of years, and accused Keir Starmer’s No 10 of sidelining her during the launch of a key immigration policy when she was home secretary.
paragraphs.zh: 伊薇特·库珀承认，工党在过去几年里“治理得并不好”，并指责基尔·斯塔默的唐宁街10号在她担任内政大臣期间，在推出一项关键移民政策时将她边缘化。

paragraphs.en: Speaking on the Political Currency podcast with the former Conservative chancellor George Osborne, Cooper highlighted some of the difficulties ministers faced with Starmer’s leadership, which she summarised as “bring me solutions, not problems”.
paragraphs.zh: 库珀在与前保守党财政大臣乔治·奥斯本共同主持的《政治货币》播客节目中，强调了部长们在斯塔默领导下遇到的一些困难，她将其概括为“给我解决方案，而不是问题”。

paragraphs.en: She said she had found a more collegiate style under Andy Burnham, and argued in favour of trying to form a national consensus around social care and reintroducing Sure Start-style children’s centres for young families under his leadership.
paragraphs.zh: 她说，她在安迪·伯纳姆领导下感受到了更具协作性的风格，并主张在他的领导下，尝试围绕社会关怀形成全国共识，并重新引入类似“确定性开端”（Sure Start）计划的儿童中心，以服务年轻家庭。

paragraphs.en: Contrasting the new prime minister with Starmer, the health secretary said there had been “a style of leading the government that maybe doesn’t necessarily work in politics” under the last administration.
paragraphs.zh: 在将新首相与斯塔默进行对比时，卫生大臣表示，上一届政府存在“一种未必适用于政治的领导政府方式”。

paragraphs.en: As an example, she was critical of how she was in effect excluded from launching the immigration white paper in May 2025 while home secretary.
paragraphs.zh: 她举例批评道，2025年5月在担任内政大臣期间，她在实际上被排除在移民白皮书发布之外。

paragraphs.en: At the launch, which was fronted by Starmer, he spoke of introducing policies to deal with the risk that Britain could become an “island of strangers”, which Cooper later had to defend.
paragraphs.zh: 在那场由斯塔默主导的发布会上，他谈到要出台政策应对英国可能成为“陌生人之岛”的风险，而这一说法后来不得不由库珀出面维护。

paragraphs.en: She told Osborne: “Keir wanted the immigration white paper. Actually, we did a lot of the work on it in the Home Office, and a whole set of plans to bring legal migration back under control, a whole set of reforms around illegal migration and so on.
paragraphs.zh: 她告诉奥斯本：“基尔想要这份移民白皮书。实际上，内政部在其中做了大量工作，包括一整套让合法移民重回可控状态的计划、一系列围绕非法移民的改革等等。”

paragraphs.en: “But then No 10 wanted Keir to announce it on his own and to front that up, and so I didn’t see what was going to be said or what the announcement was … that was the way that No 10 operated.
paragraphs.zh: “但随后唐宁街10号希望由基尔独自宣布并主导此事，所以我不知道要说什么，也不知道公告内容是什么……这就是唐宁街10号的运作方式。”
